CustomField.description: Base URL of the SFCC storefront (including locale path, e.g. /en-ae) used to build the deposit/balance payment links sent in customer emails. If SFCC/MRT returns a relative path in its "link" response field, this is prepended to form the full URL; an absolute link from SFCC is used as-is. Read by CARASplitPaymentSettings via CARASplitPaymentNotificationService.
CustomField.label: Storefront Base URI
